provenance.observation: Validator imports hashlib/hmac and documents HMAC validation, but validate_receipt does not execute a cryptographic HMAC comparison; producer_commitment validation checks only field presence.
GATE 4 converts provenance-verifier failure into a warning and then emits a verified message; Lane 04 subsequently records signature_valid=true and provenance_chain=true unconditionally.
PR text states HMAC-SHA256 signatures prove receipt provenance while full federated receipt validation was still awaiting samples.

evidence_for: get_producer_secret returns a placeholder string and is not called by validate_receipt
validate_producer_commitment verifies required fields but not HMAC bytes
GATE 4 uses `|| echo WARNING` rather than fail-closed propagation
Lane 04 audit entry hardcodes signature_valid=true and provenance_chain=true
evidence_against: The broker is workflow_dispatch and Lane 00 still requires a governance decision before final receipt approval
No external producer receipt falsely promoted to a published claim was observed in this cycle
failure_mode: Structural signature/provenance fields can be recorded as validated even when cryptographic HMAC verification and cross-repo provenance verification have not actually passed.
falsifier: A reproducible broker run with a deliberately wrong HMAC and a deliberately broken provenance chain is rejected before Lane 04, while a correctly signed receipt with immutable remote provenance passes both checks.
next_probe: Add positive and negative HMAC KATs, make provenance verification fail-closed, derive Lane 04 booleans from actual gate outputs, then run one wrong-signature and one broken-provenance fixture.

mitigation.action: Keep external federation claim_allowed=false; do not treat signature_valid or provenance_chain as true until cryptographic and remote checks return terminal PASS.
mitigation.rollback: Disable external federation path or revert broker to self-test-only mode if a receipt can reach Lane 04 without cryptographic/provenance PASS.

closure_gate.criterion: Negative fixtures are rejected fail-closed and positive fixture passes HMAC plus immutable provenance verification with captured logs/receipt.
closure_gate.evidence_needed: CI run IDs, terminal job steps, HMAC KAT outputs, provenance verifier outputs, commit SHA and evidence receipt.
closure_gate.falsifier: Any invalid signature/provenance fixture reaches Lane 04 with all_gates_passed=true.

review_or_expiry: Re-evaluate on any change to broker, federated validator, federation policy, producer onboarding or external federation enablement.

detector.signal: Lane 04 says signature_valid/provenance_chain=true without an observed cryptographic/provenance PASS artifact
detector.threshold: any federation run where derived evidence for either boolean is absent
detector.false_positive: gate output exists in an artifact not visible to the current connector
detector.false_negative: hardcoded success masks a failed verifier
detector.evidence_needed: gate outputs, logs, receipt digest and verifier exit codes

maintenance.trigger: merge/change to broker, validator, policy, HMAC key handling or producer registry
maintenance.verification: rerun negative and positive federation fixtures before reusing prior validation evidence

incident_investigation.trigger: post-merge inspection of federated producer infrastructure
competing_mechanisms: provenance verifier may be absent or non-terminal
contributing_factors: structural validation conflated with cryptographic validation
incident_investigation.recommendation: make every security/provenance assertion derive from explicit terminal gate evidence

safety_assurance.data_acquisition: capture actual validator/verifier exit codes and artifacts for positive/negative fixtures
safety_assurance.analysis: compare claimed booleans against terminal gate outputs
safety_assurance.system_reassessment: propagate invalidation to R4/R5/R6/R11/R12 if any gate can be bypassed
safety_assurance.corrective_trigger: invalid fixture is accepted or downstream success is logged without evidence

learning.reusable_control: security/provenance booleans must be evidence-derived, never hardcoded
learning.index_or_test: negative HMAC and broken-provenance fixtures become mandatory regression tests
learning.recurrence_check: every broker/validator/policy change invalidates previous federation assurance until tests rerun
